description: This PHP script manages the assignment and linking of platforms to test plans within the TestLink project. It handles displaying the interface, processing user input for linking/unlinking platforms, and initializing related data structures.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template rendering class used to assign variables and display the web interface.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class used to manage test plan data and operations such as counting linked test case versions and changing platform assignments.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: Class to manage platform data, including retrieving all platforms and linked platforms for a test plan.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP class used to create simple objects for GUI data.

methods.name: init_option_panels
methods.description: Initializes option transfer panels for assigning platforms, including creating a map of platform names to linked counts for UI warnings.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Parses and initializes argument parameters from user input for controlling platform assignment actions.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the rights to add or remove platforms from test plans.
